stations.title: Rhona
stations.say: One copy of these, not two.

stations.title: Radio desk
stations.text: Has its own copy of the reading functions.

stations.title: Rhona
stations.note: And a total for each hill.

captions: At the base, Rhona asks for one copy of the code that reads the callout log.
Today Ailsa is copying the functions out of the report, so two copies will drift apart.
You move them into callouts.py, keep its try-out lines quiet on import, and add to it.
Now the report and the radio desk import the same functions from one module.
Rhona's report reads the log just as Ailsa's desk does, and shows the hours on each hill.
